description: Create environment — Creates a new environment in the current app. The env starts in the no-pin state — promote (POST `/v1/environments/{id}/promote`) is the only path to pin a version. Synchronously provisions a per-env Fly app; failure rolls back the env row and surfaces 500 `env_fly_provisioning_failed`. Per FR-028 no API key is auto-minted; the response includes `api_key_creation_url` for the post-create CTA.
name: create_environment
